title: Follow/Undo{Follow} bypass HTTP Signature verification
description: Trigger: POST /ap/groups/{g}/inbox with Follow or Undo{Follow} activity. verify_http_signature is only called for Create activities. Follow and Undo activities are dispatched without signature verification even when verify_http_signatures=true. Any attacker who knows a group name can subscribe or unsubscribe arbitrary actors, pollute the follower store, and trigger Accept deliveries to arbitrary inboxes without a valid signature.
